parent_objective: audit no-update exact evaluator for role-safe contour-aware policy targets
blocked_by: M1633 evaluates exact residuals but blocks actor update until result audit

public_gates: M1634 must audit the M1633 exact evaluator result
M1634 must verify positive residual and diagnostic guardrail integrity
M1634 must decide whether objective-only actor-update design is admitted or whether evaluator repair is needed
M1634 must keep PPO promotion and private holdout blocked
M1634 must not strengthen self-ID claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat diagnostics as positive targets
do not treat donor_plus_hidden_action as a loss target

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits the no-update exact evaluator result before any objective-only actor update design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no actor update, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if M1633 residuals are missing or nonfinite
stop if diagnostic role guardrails failed
stop if checkpoint mutation or donor-plus loss-target violation occurred
stop if actor-update design admission is ambiguous
fallback_plan: admit objective-only actor-update design if evaluator result is clean
pivot to evaluator repair if metrics or guardrails fail
route to branch synthesis if update-design admission is ambiguous

admission_evidence: M1633 reported public pass and clean guardrails
allowed_updates: M1634 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest if audit admits actor-update design, repair, synthesis, or stop
next_stage_criteria: objective-only update-design admission or fallback is explicit
training and PPO remain blocked unless a later design admits them

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1634 audits fixed-tensor evaluator plumbing and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audits correct/wrong hidden action residuals on public rows
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If evaluator result is insufficient, record the blocker and pivot before actor update design.
allowed_claims: no-update exact evaluator audit and route decision
no actor update, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1633 exact evaluator result is clean enough to decide whether objective-only actor-update design can be admitted.
success_criteria: M1633 summary and evaluator artifacts are audited
audit states supported and unsupported claims
PPO promotion and private holdout remain blocked unless a later design admits them
failure_criteria: audit skips residual role-integrity or guardrail review
audit routes directly to PPO promotion private holdout or actor-input changes
audit claims paper-level or level3 self-identification evidence
decision_rule: M1634 passes if it audits the exact evaluator and chooses a safe next route before actor update design.
